title: Report 09: SaaS signup and checkout friction
population: Business software tools we signed up for and tested hands-on in our own accounts: 309 tools, 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-19.
selection: Not a sample of the market: tools from our review corpus that we tested hands-on and that have at least one published screenshot. A feature counts for a tool only when the test record states it and a screenshot from the same test shows it.

headline.text: tools that put a card, a phone number or a required connection between sign-up and first use

metrics.label: tools that asked for a payment card before the free plan or trial would start
tools that required a phone number at sign-up
tools that showed nothing until we connected another account or verified a domain
tools that had paid extras ticked by default in the checkout
tools that showed a checkout total above the advertised price
tools that had no cancel button we could find in the product
tools that gave no usable result within our test session
cancellations that ended with the account password

limitations: Not a random sample: tools we review and could test ourselves, mostly for small and mid-sized businesses.
Each percentage uses only the tools where that step was visible in our test, so the base differs per finding.
One account and one plan per tool, at the date shown; vendors change sign-up and checkout flows often.
Findings are coded by an AI model from our own test records and kept only when a literal quote and a screenshot back them; we checked samples by hand.
next_full_recheck: with every new batch of hands-on tests (new edition)
